C0712.title: Woman Penalized for Using AI to Mass-Produce Clickbait Content
C0712.summary: In June 2026, the cyber police unit of Shehong Public Security Bureau found during routine online patrols that local resident Dong had posted false information on Toutiao, claiming that a drunk person had attacked others with a knife near Shehong pedestrian street. Investigation found that Dong used AI tools to mass-produce clickbait articles and spread them through online communities and self-media platforms for traffic, earning 15 yuan over nearly a year. Police determined that the conduct constituted spreading rumors and disrupting public order, imposed an administrative penalty, and ordered the false information deleted.
